product_one_liner.value: TwelveLabs builds video-native multimodal AI models and APIs that help developers and organizations search, analyze, and understand video content.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its platform as enterprise video AI and its own models as tools for multimodal video understanding.

pricing_page.notes: The public page lists Free, Plus, Pro, and Enterprise plans, including prices for the self-serve tiers.

named_customers.notes: These organizations appear among the company’s customer case studies; case-study organizations are used rather than partners or investors.

employee_band.notes: A company headcount profile reports about 176 people (and another 2026 directory estimate is about 193); this falls in the 101-200 band. LinkedIn’s broader displayed range is 51-200.

hq_location.notes: The company profile identifies San Francisco, California as headquarters; the company site lists its San Francisco office.

founded_year.notes: The company’s LinkedIn profile lists 2021 as its founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The blog includes multiple technical build/research pieces, including an engineering account of rebuilding its HLS pipeline and a technical report on video foundation-model evaluation with named technical contributors.

public_docs.notes: TwelveLabs provides a public documentation site with API reference, SDK, getting-started, and model documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live job board lists a Staff ML Research Engineer role focused on multimodal structure and Marengo.

model_provider.value: TwelveLabs’ own Marengo and Pegasus models; no underlying third-party model provider is named for these models.
model_provider.notes: The product and documentation describe Marengo and Pegasus as TwelveLabs models. Integrations with assistants such as Claude or ChatGPT are separate from the provider of TwelveLabs’ video models.

compliance_certs.notes: The company’s certification announcement explicitly says it completed SOC 2 Type 2. No other requested certification is included because none was verified as a current certification.

last_funding.notes: TwelveLabs announced its $100 million Series B on July 1, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The July 2026 Series B falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job board and careers page show open positions, but no role titled SDR, BDR, Sales Development Representative, Business Development Representative, or Account Executive was identified.

launched_6mo.notes: The company announced Marengo 3.5 (August 2026), Pegasus 1.6 (October 2026), and Jockey GA updates in October 2026, all within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: I found current leadership/team material and a dated October 2026 staff feature, but no sufficiently verifiable dated source establishing that a C-level or VP-level person joined or left between November 9, 2025 and November 9, 2026. The false value is only a required placeholder; the answer is unknown.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The public integrations documentation and readable job board were checked; neither names a CRM or sales/marketing system that TwelveLabs visibly uses.
